name: Kangar City Half Marathon 2026
short_description: Kangar City Half Marathon 2026 is on Saturday 24 October 2026 in Kangar, over 1 km, 5 km, 10 km and 21.1 km.
ai_summary: The Kangar City Half Marathon 2026 is organised by Northern Runners Resources in Kangar, Perlis, as a two-day event on 23 and 24 October 2026. The 1 km kids dash runs at 6:30 pm on Friday 23 October, and the 21 km half marathon flags off at 2:30 am on Saturday 24 October, followed by the 10 km city run at 4:00 am and the 5 km fun run at 7:30 am.

faqs.question: When does the 21 km at the Kangar City Half Marathon 2026 start?
faqs.answer: The 21 km half marathon flags off at 2:30 am on Saturday 24 October 2026, with a cut-off of 6:30 am (4 hours). The 10 km flags off at 4:00 am with a 2.5-hour cut-off and the 5 km at 7:30 am with a 1.5-hour cut-off.

faqs.question: What happens on Friday 23 October?
faqs.answer: The 1 km kids dash is the only category on the Friday, flagging off at 6:30 pm with a 30-minute cut-off. All the longer distances run in the early hours of Saturday 24 October.
